method: Viewed 115-dpi Poppler page renders in five labeled contact sheets covering pages25–51; additionally viewed page27 individually at native render resolution. Inspected margins, equations, section starts, code snippets, declaration-index wrapping and bibliography. Source-level semantic review is separate.
rendering_checks: No clipped text, overlapping elements, missing glyphs, blank content pages or displaced page numbers observed.
Native encoder outline finishes cleanly and subsequent unchanged theorem sections remain legible.
Declaration index and long bibliography URLs stay within margins.
LaTeX log contains no overfull/underfull boxes, warnings or undefined references.
